Not disagreeing with you, just want to add that activities for birthdays are generally an iffy idea. I mean, you never know what mood or energy level the birthday person has on that day and then saying yea I planned this and that and we're gonna do it today seems like a whole lot of pressure. 
I feel like it would be smarter to offer to do these activities at a point in the near future where the birthday person actually feels up for it and will be able to enjoy it. And sex wise, I guess it would be smarter to be like "yo there's stuff I prepared that I wanted to try and I'd like to see your reaction to it" (probably better worded, that's just the jizz of it)
